verdict.summary: The change correctly replaces the fixed-size, newest-first quarantine read with exhaustive REST pagination, normalizes the REST field names consumed by the approval check, excludes pull requests, and fails closed on API failure, malformed timestamps, or a runaway result set. The focused self-test is behavioral rather than vacuous: it exercises a 250-item multi-page queue, proves the oldest item is retained, checks stale versus post-edit reactions through the normalized timestamp, and covers both ceiling and fetch failures. The workflow runs these tests before label mutations, and the added docs-quality gate makes regressions visible on pull requests. The focused promote.py self-test passes.
